# The Two Captains

## Premise
A dockmaster must untangle a smuggling ring before the harbor masters hang the wrong man.

## World / Characters
1. Dockmaster Ivane, who keeps the harbor ledgers
2. Captain Rose, a grey-haired smuggler of the northern run

## Manuscript

### Chapter 1: The Ledger
Ivane found the discrepancy in the grain tallies and knew at once whose ship it was. Captain Rose — old, grey-bearded, with a wooden leg and forty years on the northern run — had signed the false manifest in his cramped, familiar hand. Ivane had known the man since boyhood. It grieved her to mark his name in the book of the accused, but the numbers did not lie, and the harbor masters would want their culprit by the new moon.

### Chapter 2: The Other Rose
At the tavern Ivane met Captain Rose again — but this Captain Rose was a young woman, raven-haired, barely thirty, newly arrived from the southern isles with a fast sloop and a clean record. She too signed her manifests "Captain Rose," for it was her name as much as the old man's. Ivane stared from one ledger to the other. Two captains, one name, and somewhere between them the truth of the missing grain. The harbor masters had arrested the old man already.
